sources.src/PLC_PRG.st:
PROGRAM PLC_PRG
VAR_INPUT Start : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT Out : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR edge : R_TRIG; END_VAR
edge(CLK := Start);
Out := edge.Q;
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM PLC_PRG
VAR_INPUT Start : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT Out : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR timer : TON; END_VAR
timer(IN := Start, PT := T#40MS);
Out := timer.Q;
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM PLC_PRG
VAR_INPUT Start : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT Out : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR buffer : ARRAY[0..2] OF BOOL; END_VAR
buffer[0] := Start;
Out := buffer[0];
END_PROGRAM

FUNCTION_BLOCK RelayFB

VAR_OUTPUT Value : BOOL; END_VAR
